properties.name: WaitTimeCategory
properties.summary: Type of the "Wait" meter. Contains numeric values -1..10, meaning DOWN(-1), IDLE(0), LOW(1), ..., HIGH(5), LOW_ABNORMAL(6), ..., HIGH_ABNORMAL(10). In DPA UI, values 1-5 are shown as blue meter, abnormal values 6-10 have red meter. Normal/abnormal is an intra-instance information, indicating whether wait time of this particular instance is higher than usual for this instance, based on historical data. Values LOW - HIGH (normal as well as abnormal) represent inter-instance comparison, ie. how big/significant is today's wait time of this particular instance when compared to today's wait times of the other monitored instances.

summary: Provides data-points of DB resources. It has single parameter that is required (DatabaseId) and two more that specifies what data will be returned for a given query. If one specifies both ResourceName and CategoryName in a WHERE clause than result set will contain single-resource data-points for specified time-frame (or default time-frame if Time property was not limited in WHERE clause). If at least one of these two parameters is missing than the result set will contain multiple-metric data-points limited by one data-point per metric (i.e. result set will contain a set of last data-point collected for each metric, if such data-point exists in last 60 minutes)

properties.name: DatabaseId
properties.summary: Specifies for which DB instance should resource data-points be fetched. Reference to Orion.DPA.DatabaseInstance.Id

properties.name: GlobalDatabaseId
properties.summary: Unique ID of database instance in Orion

properties.name: ResourceName
properties.summary: Specifies a name of a resource (e.g. Active Sessions, Memory Utilization, Signal Waits Percent) that must be equal to one of the records from DPA.ResourceDefinition.Name

properties.name: CategoryName
properties.summary: Specifies a name of a category a resource belongs (e.g. CPU, Memory, Sessions) that must be equal to one of the records from DPA.ResourceDefinition.CategoryName

properties.name: Time
properties.summary: Specifies a time of a data-point

properties.name: Value
properties.summary: Specifies a double-precision value of this data-point in given time

properties.name: TimeUnit
properties.summary: Specifies a time-frame for which data-points should be fetched. If both Time > ABC and Time < XYZ are specified in WHERE clause this property will be ignored. It can take one of the following values: hour (3), day (4), week (5), month (6), six moths (61) or year (7). If Time is limited only by one side (< or >) than a time-frame will be specified as Time-TimeUnit to Time respectively Time to Time+TimeUnit

properties.name: TimesliceUnit
properties.summary: Force granularity of records within Time interval (by default there is auto detection based on the Time interval), supported values: as collected ('-1'), ten minutes (22), hour (3), day (4)
